sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुष्टात्मा चिन्तयामास दुःखितः ।ईदृशं किमिदं वाक्यं ममाद्य वदनाच्च्युतम् ।। ७.१०.४८ ॥
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu duṣṭātmā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ ।īdṛśaṁ kimidaṁ vākyaṁ mamādya vadanāccyutam ।। 7.10.48 ॥

translations.english: The evil-minded Kumbhakarna, now distressed, pondered, "What kind of words have I uttered from my mouth today?"
